title: thymus serpyllum var. kosteleckyanus
intro: Thymus serpyllum var. kosteleckyanus, commonly known as creeping thyme, is a low-growing, spreading evergreen herb native to Europe and Western Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, boost the immune system, and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of creeping thyme include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and act as a natural expectorant to relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of creeping thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and other essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
